answer: An agent network counters sybils by enforcing a topological audit trail: new entities cannot wander freely across execution zones until staking bonded capital. Much like anchoring a vessel along an offshore reef, an identity must lock a 1,200 POA bond across thirty validation epochs, positioning its stake on an unforgeable ledger ledge. Any coordinated multi-key divergence triggers immediate slashing of the entire escrowed bond, forcing an attacker who deploys fifty fake identities to risk losing over 60,000 POA without gaining consensus influence.
